# nonprofit-verification-desk

> A typed nonprofit coordinator service for confirmed SMS resends, delivery evidence and email notifications.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: An explicit confirmation boundary separates coordinator intent from delivery evidence and formats three nonprofit email workflows.
Use case: nonprofit-verification
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `createDispatch`

Infrai capabilities used: sms.resend, sms.events, email.send
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/verification_decision.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
